<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?route source="north"?>
<!-- Preserve native preamble instructions before the trusted public declaration. -->
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<?after-doctype owner="platform"?>
<plist version="1.0">
  <?plist-state mode="protected"?>
  <dict>
    <?dictionary-start signal="kept"?>
    <!-- Explain the formatted harbor route to translators. -->
    <?before-key owner="structure"?>
    <key>harbor.route</key>
    <?between-key-value owner="structure"?>
    <string>Guide %1$@ across north water</string>
    <?after-value owner="structure"?>

    <!-- Keep an originally self-closing entry source-preserving. -->
    <key>quiet.empty</key>
    <?before-empty signal="stable"?>
    <string custom="protected" />

    <!-- Native CDATA and literal markup remain visible text. -->
    <key>wrapped&signal</key>
    <?before-cdata signal="stable"?>
    <string><![CDATA[<calm> & clear]]></string>
    <?dictionary-end signal="kept"?>
  </dict>
  <?plist-end mode="protected"?>
</plist>
<?document-end source="north"?>
